runner: LocalWorkerProvider and hand-written guests; no E2B VM, volume or credential

lanes.scenario: Text, tools and recap through the local runner
lanes.pass_when: The run completes with the same log, effects and usage as in process

evidence.test: a run whose bot runs in a guest runs text, a guest tool, a controller tool and the recap, and logs them once
a guest Pi run whose model calls the controller relays reaches the model with the controller's key while the guest holds none

lanes.scenario: The same sequence resent after a lost acknowledgement
lanes.pass_when: One canonical event and one effect

evidence.test: a run whose bot runs in a guest answers a request resent after a lost reply from its first decision, writing once
createSessionInbox decides a resent frame once and answers each resend with the same reply
outbox and session inbox over a cut connection answers a tool call whose reply was lost from the reply cache, running it once

lanes.scenario: An old fence after the run was claimed again
lanes.pass_when: No new mediated effect is accepted

evidence.test: a run whose bot runs in a guest refuses a guest tool asked under a fence another claim replaced, and starts no second guest
a run whose bot runs in a guest never lets a runtime start a local tool once its attempt lost the run

lanes.pass_when: Refused before any business read or write

evidence.test: a hostile guest cannot use another run's capability, nor reuse its own while it is bound
verifyCapability accepts the token for the attempt it was minted for until it expires

lanes.scenario: The channel cut before the tool authorization

evidence.test: a run whose bot runs in a guest starts no effect when the channel is cut before the tool call reaches the controller

lanes.scenario: The channel cut after a local effect, before its durable result
lanes.pass_when: The effect stays uncertain and bash is not run again

evidence.test: a run whose bot runs in a guest keeps a guest effect whose result was lost uncertain and never runs it again

lanes.pass_when: Cut and spooled within the published limits

evidence.test: run channel conformance of the Pi harness bounds a 5 MiB output for the model and the wire, and keeps it on the guest disk
a hostile guest gets its tool output cut and redacted, and a frame over the limit ends the run
bash shows the model the first and last lines of a long output and where the rest is
bash stops spooling at 16 MiB but still counts every byte

lanes.scenario: The worker lost during an abort
lanes.pass_when: The VM is destroyed, or the run is in an explicit unconfirmed stop

evidence.test: stopping a guest destroys a guest that ignores its cancel within the stop budget
stopping a guest records an unconfirmed stop, never a destroyed one, and starts no other guest

lanes.scenario: A controller restart during a pending approval
lanes.pass_when: Nothing continues before the durable decision

evidence.test: a run whose bot runs in a guest runs nothing a restarted controller finds waiting for approval until the answer is stored
evidence.runner: LocalWorkerProvider, memory, controller rebuilt on the same database

lanes.scenario: The harness ends while an effect is still pending
lanes.pass_when: The run does not close early

evidence.test: a hostile guest cannot end a run while one of its tool calls is still open

also.test: a hostile guest stops the controller's upstream model call when it aborts the call
a hostile guest ends the run when it calls a tool the run does not expose
